text: How do we know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?
prefix: How do we know a new merchant really owns the email they typed?

text: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.
prefix: Anyone can type any address, so a sign-up alone proves nothing.

text: The contract adds three calls: register, verify the email, and resend the code.
prefix: The contract adds three calls: register, verify the email, and resend the code.

text: Registering saves the merchant as pending, and refuses an email that is already taken.
prefix: Registering saves the merchant as pending, and refuses an email that is already taken.

text: A one-time code then goes to that email, from a new OTP starter that any module can use.
prefix: A one-time code then goes to that email, from a new OTP starter that any module can use.

text: Redis keeps only a hash of the code, with a configured lifetime, so even a copy of Redis never reveals it.
prefix: Redis keeps only a hash of the code, with a configured lifetime, so even a copy of Redis never reveals it.

text: The email goes out through the notification service, and locally it lands in Mailpit, where we can read it.
prefix: The email goes out through the notification service, and locally it lands in Mailpit, where we can read it.

text: The merchant sends the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.
prefix: The merchant sends the code back, and only then is the email marked as verified.

text: Wrong codes count against a configured limit, and too many lock the code.
prefix: Wrong codes count against a configured limit, and too many lock the code.

text: Sends are limited too, so nobody can flood an inbox.
prefix: Sends are limited too, so nobody can flood an inbox.

text: Every failure has its own stable code: email taken, code invalid, code expired, or too many attempts.
prefix: Every failure has its own stable code: email taken, code invalid, code expired, or too many attempts.

text: Under load, about five thousand merchants registered and verified their email in thirty seconds.
